headline: Dover to Acquire Cloeren, a Leading Manufacturer of T-dies and Feedblocks
summary: Dover Corporation (NYSE: DOV) today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cloeren Incorporated ("Cloeren"). Cloeren will become part of the MAAG business unit within Dover's Pumps & Process Solutions segment following the closing of the deal.
